description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements the 'LogNode' interface to filter log messages by passing only message content, omitting metadata such as priority, tag, and Throwable. It is used for simplifying log output, especially in UI display contexts.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that passes only the message component of logs to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating a filter without a predefined next node.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Filters the log message to pass only the message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain for log message forwarding.
